next.reason: 1985: "must describe the same number of character positions" for every parameter passed by reference; 2023: a group argument or formal parameter takes the group rules (§2023:14.8.2.1), where each side "shall be an alphanumeric group item or an elementary item of category alphanumeric" and the formal parameter may be the same or a smaller number of bytes (§2023:14.8.2.2 rule 1). A shorter group formal parameter is legal; a group against a numeric item of the same size is not.
